actions.action: Preserve permission changes as dated events
actions.mechanism: Append withdrawals instead of overwriting permission records, preserving the distinction between past authorization and future display eligibility.
actions.implementation: Record asset ID, affected venues/dates, withdrawal receipt time, and effective scope under existing terms; retain original grants and display logs.
actions.check: Withdraw permission after an authorized exhibition; verify its historical authorization remains visible while affected future dates fail permission checks.
actions.risk: Incorrect effective dates could misclassify displays.

actions.action: Verify permission for the actual installation
actions.mechanism: Evaluate the identified print against the destination venue and display dates, rather than showing universal approval.
actions.implementation: Put only an asset ID and verification QR on public labels. Require venue/date entry and a current permission check before display.
actions.check: Scan one print for authorized and withdrawn venue/date combinations; confirm different results. An unavailable current record must not produce approval.
actions.risk: Wrong venue selection or copied labels can misidentify context.

actions.mechanism: Separate permission to pack from permission to install; reconcile every offline decision against current records.
actions.implementation: Cache versioned venue/date permissions for one workday. Record packed asset IDs and intended destinations; require synchronized manifest reconciliation before releasing installation tasks.
actions.check: Pack offline, withdraw a packed asset, then synchronize; confirm the asset is blocked and unresolved manifests cannot release installation.
actions.risk: A manual installation bypass could defeat the reconciliation gate.

actions.action: Intercept withdrawn prints already in transit
actions.mechanism: Connect permission changes to physical custody so a withdrawal prompts removal even after packing or delivery.
actions.implementation: Map asset IDs to crates and destination custodians. Flag affected shipments, issue hold tasks without contributor contact details, and require asset-level isolation acknowledgments.
actions.check: Withdraw a print inside a sealed outbound crate; verify its custodian receives a hold and records isolation before installation.
actions.risk: Incorrect crate mappings or missed acknowledgments require escalation.
